title: "[NEW]"
labels: ''

---

**Proposed Category/Section Name:**
What should the new category or section be called? (e.g., "Sorting Algorithms", "Graph Theory", "Concurrency")

**Description of the Category/Section:**
Provide a description of the new category. What types of tests should be included here? Why does this category make sense?

**Justification:**
Why do you think a new category is needed? Is the list growing too large to be useful without categorization? Does this section address a gap in the current organization?

**Additional Context (Optional):**
Any relevant information, such as how other property test lists are categorized or specific resources that belong in the new section.
